⚙️ General Settings

⚡ Quick Edit Inventory

Edit stock and selling price directly in the inventory table.

📅 Enable Sales Date

🔌 USB Scanner

Enable physical USB/Bluetooth barcode scanner globally

⭐ Show Favorites in Record Sale

Display the Favorites panel beside the Shopping Cart in Record Sale.

||||| Quick Sale with Barcode

Show the barcode scanner icon in the product search field on the Record Sale screen.

📦 Product Features

📅 Expiry Tracking

Enable expiry dates and tracking for products.

💰 Buying Price Tracking

Show buying prices in product and inventory views. (Always visible in Purchases).

Configure multi-level godowns, floors, racks, and shelves for precise inventory tracking.
